method: Release, warm file cache, three repetitions per isolated pass and full pipeline for up to 16 largest functions. Pipeline includes lifting/SSA, import hydration, combined SSA argument/return solver, final ABI/stack/version-specific types, semantic HIR and diagnostic rendering. Semantic lowering, rendering and serialization are measured separately. Legacy AST serialization is outside pipeline timing. Five fresh CLI processes per command, startup included; outliers retained. OS peak working set observed at 5 ms intervals. Program counts show whether there were supplied seeds and any propagated claims; a converged empty demand set is not recovered type coverage. No GUI or idle CPU measurement.
